demand_sensing_agent.systems: Dassault Systemes ENOVIA · SAP S/4HANA Aerospace · FAA Airworthiness Registry · BigQuery · Vertex AI TimesFM

category_should_cost.systems: SAP Ariba · Dassault CATIA CAD/BOM · Titanium Fastener Indices · BigQuery Parametric Models
category_should_cost.problemDetails: Aerospace-grade titanium forgings, carbon fiber composite pre-pregs, and complex CNC machined ribs suffer from monopolistic supplier pricing and unpredictable metal surcharges.
category_should_cost.solutionDetails: Performs bottom-up parametric should-cost analysis decomposing 5-axis CNC machining hours, autoclave cure cycles, and raw titanium ingot prices to establish should-cost benchmarks.
category_should_cost.outcomeDetails: Yields $140M in validated cost savings during multi-year aerostructure and avionics supplier renegotiations.
